name: Audit D-07: global operations need the permission in tenant 1
description: The permission tree, providers, resource types/roles/flags, token types, languages, system parameters and event codes are global. A tenant-B admin holding every permission in B is rejected (32001); the same permissions in tenant 1 work whatever _tenant_id is passed. System parameters and event codes need a real permission (system.*). Translations are validated against _tenant_id. Runs as non-system users.
